name: Balan

attributes.attribute: Arthurian knight and brother of the Fisher King

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text:
Balan is a cross-reference entry in this encyclopedia. The original text points the reader to the entry for Balin. Balan itself carries no separate biography. The source gives only the pointer line.

The Balin entry tells the shared account. It describes an Arthurian knight named Balin. He was the brother of Pelles, the Fisher King. Balin struck the Dolorous Blow. That single strike caused the Fisher King's crippling wound. Readers seeking the story of Balan should turn to the Balin entry.
